source_evidence.text:
3. Development of a new dataset to test com-
bined reasoning over a general and a domain-
specific KG, and evaluation of Tree-of-
Traversals on this dataset.
We conduct detailed experiments on three mod-
els of varied sizes hosted on Amazon Bedrock and
present detailed ablation studies.
2
Tree-of-Traversals
The Tree-of-Traversals algorithm maintains a local
KG subgraph that is repeatedly expanded until it
contains all the information required by an LLM
to answer the given query. At the start, a local
KG subgraph is initialized to contain the entities
present in the original query. It is then expanded
using a tree search algorithm to choose actions and
thoughts generated by an LLM in order to obtain
relevant knowledge from the KG using a KG inter-
face. The algorithm halts when the LLM is able
to answer the original query using the local KG
subgraph as context. Tree-of-Traversals consists of
three major components. (1) A knowledge graph
interface implemented to interact with one or more
required KGs. (2) An action state machine (ASM)
which is a finite state machine that defines the fea-
sible space of actions, states, and prompt templates
when the LLM interacts with a KG to expand the
local KG subgraph. (3) A tree search algorithm
which defines the overall LLM search trajectory
such as best first search, backtrack upon making a
mistake, and termination condition when an answer
is found.

relation_review.semantics: 核对关系方向、实体角色、任务/实验条件和题干前提。
relation_review.uncertainty: 必要证据不足时明确说明缺口；反例允许纠正前提。

scoring_rules.primary: R11 candidate source coverage before/after quote-normalization routing fix; remaining 23 cases are unchanged replay context
scoring_rules.gold: any known_support_chunks match counts; non-exhaustive frozen support pools
scoring_rules.separate: paper inclusion is not required source passage coverage; neither is answer accuracy
scoring_rules.pairing: win/tie/loss plus source additions/removals, including equal-score substitutions
scoring_rules.cost: new embedding call and shared batch time separate; retrieval per query measured; historical router cost separate
scoring_rules.causal_limit: R11 is one diagnostic item; source support pools are frozen and non-exhaustive; no rerank or answer quality claim.

evaluation_config.planned_output: 仅候选召回：同40条上限与全部并集；不重排、不生成

controls.other_cases: reuse original recall results byte-for-byte except replay metadata
controls.R11_original: reuse previous original-question result and its frozen Q0 channel hits
controls.R11_expanded: reuse Q0; freshly retrieve only the four fixed router subqueries using the same production indexes and compatible BGE
controls.merge: rank ascending, query order original then SQ, channel order fulltext then dense; first discovery order; no cross-query RRF
